components.text: Curses the owner of the taglock: one of the skills they have learned is chosen, and it cannot be activated or switched on while the curse lasts. A sealed skill that is on is switched off.

Anyone can cast it. The target is the owner of the taglock; Tensura must be installed.

The curse ends when the target dies. It needs infernal chalk, not ritual chalk.

Circle: medium circle, infernal chalk.
